title: Text requests get a steadier pace
summary:
Text requests now queue by IP group at a steadier pace, and OpenAI generation forwards the requested temperature.

Text requests now run one at a time, with at least three seconds between starts for each IP group. The separate 40-requests-per-minute limit is unchanged.

IPv4 addresses sharing their first three segments now share a text-request queue rather than being queued individually.

The OpenAI generation path now forwards the requested temperature, so that setting reaches the model.
